title: Jesus Came, the Heavens Adoring
description: Jesus Came, the Heavens Adoring in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Godfrey Thring, first published in 1864. The tune, SIEH, HIER BIN ICH, EHRENKOENIG, is from Geistreiches Gesangbuch Darmstadt, 1698. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Je-sus came, the heav'ns a-dor-ing, Came with peace from realms on high; Je-sus came for man's re-demp-tion, Low-ly came on earth to die. Al-le-lu-ia!_ Al-le-lu-ia! Came in_ deep hu-mil-i-ty.

lines: Came with peace from realms on high;
Lowly came on earth to die.
When our hearts are bowed with care;
Comes to save us from despair.
Jesus comes in sounds of gladness,
Now the gate of death is riv'n.
Jesus comes in joy and sorrow,
Shares alike our hopes and fears;
Glads our hearts, and dries our tears;
When the heav'ns shall pass away;
Let us then our homage pay,
Till the dawn of endless day.
